result:
All four queries now carry the name filter (each edit matched its unique anchor; the old filter endings are gone).

Summary of changes:
- The reader was right: the request identified the folder purely by four metadata filters with no name, which reads constructed. Rewrote it name-first, keeping all four facts as disambiguators: "Could you tag the Harbor launch folder created in March with launch-ready? It's the one in Favorites with exactly 3 items, last modified by Priya Nair."
- Added condition `c0` ("the Harbor launch folder", `A:Folder.name`, no decoys — allowed as a naturalness anchor) and a matching `contains_ci "Harbor launch"` filter in the reference query and all three `REPLACE` queries. Every decoy name contains it, so each decoy still fails exactly one condition; background folders fail it plus others.
- Kept "created in March" (not the vaguer "from March") so the `A:Folder.created_at` decoy that was only modified in March still unambiguously fails; no test-like hints ("not the one…", "simply") were added.

Decoys and seed are otherwise unchanged.
